tracks.title: 我毋是鮭魚 Guá M̄-sī Kue-hî
tracks.mood: deadpan, sheepish and bouncy, a joke the singer has finally stopped living inside
tracks.subject: a man who changed his legal name to 'Lim Salmon' in 2021 for a free sushi-restaurant feast and has lived with it on every bank queue screen and job interview since, back at the household registration office for his third and, by law, last name change, while the clerk reminds him this one is final
